chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her late 20s with long dark wavy hair loosely tied, wearing a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white t-shirt and grey home trousers
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man around 30 with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a dark green hoodie and black joggers
chars.FRIEND: a Moroccan man around 30 with curly black hair and a thin moustache, wearing a maroon bomber jacket over a black t-shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a modest Casablanca apartment living room. Seen from the dark hallway doorway (the husband's point of view), the WIFE is curled on the sofa secretly typing on her glowing smartphone with a sly guilty smile, glancing sideways toward the door. Head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible and lit by the phone screen. Warm lamp, blue TV glow. 2D animated illustration style, expressive faces.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, same living room. The HUSBAND sits on the sofa holding his wife's unlocked smartphone, eyes wide in shock, reading it; beside him the WIFE is asleep under a beige blanket. TV glow, a football match on screen. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, living room. The HUSBAND jumps up abruptly from the sofa clutching the phone, startled and tense, while the WIFE keeps sleeping under the blanket behind him. Dynamic motion pose, faces visible. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small Moroccan kitchen with tiled walls. The HUSBAND stands in the dark lit only by the phone screen, scrolling through a long chat, sweating, jaw clenched, disbelief on his face. Medium shot. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, a bachelor's bedroom in Casablanca. The FRIEND lies on his bed grinning mischievously while typing a message on his smartphone, screen light on his face. Head-to-waist framing. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Daytime a week earlier, a cozy Moroccan bedroom with patterned blanket. The WIFE sits on the bed typing on her phone, blushing and smiling flirtatiously, biting her lip. Head-to-waist framing. 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, the dark kitchen. Close-up of the HUSBAND frozen in shock, hand over his mouth, eyes wide, the phone glow on his face, kitchen table and a glass of water around him. 2D animated illustration style.
